target.definition: Number of recreation visits to Yellowstone National Park during September 2026, as reported in NPS monthly visitation statistics.

inputs.name: annual_visits_2025
inputs.description: Total recreation visits to Yellowstone National Park in calendar year 2025.

provenance.rationale: Recent annual visitation has hovered around 4.5–4.9 million; 2025 likely similar.

inputs.name: september_share_of_annual
inputs.description: Fraction of annual Yellowstone visits that occur in September.

provenance.rationale: September is a popular shoulder month; typical share is roughly 10–14% of annual visits.

inputs.name: daily_visits_september
inputs.description: Average number of recreation visits per day in Yellowstone during September.

provenance.rationale: September daily average is typically between 15,000 and 22,000 based on recent years.

inputs.name: september_visits_2025
inputs.description: Recreation visits to Yellowstone in September 2025.

provenance.rationale: September 2025 likely similar to recent Septembers (e.g., 2024 ~ 550k).

inputs.name: yoy_growth_factor
inputs.description: Year-over-year growth factor for September visits from 2025 to 2026.

provenance.rationale: Visitation trends are relatively stable; modest growth or decline possible.

inputs.name: us_population
inputs.description: Population of the United States in 2026.

provenance.rationale: US population is around 340 million in 2026.

inputs.name: yellowstone_visits_per_capita
inputs.description: Annual Yellowstone recreation visits per US resident.

inputs.name: september_share_of_annual_proxy
inputs.description: Fraction of annual visits occurring in September, used as a proxy from typical seasonality.

provenance.rationale: Same as september_share_of_annual but used in proxy path.

paths.description: Estimate annual visits and multiply by September's share.
Average daily visits in September times number of days.
Scale last year's September visits by a growth factor.
